entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A tough, street-smart human girl from Eldraine in a red cloak, based on Little Red Riding Hood.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Ruby's brother, who went missing and was enchanted as the Wolf Knight until Agatha died.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A traveler who journeyed with Ruby seeking a witch.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A witch whose cabin the group found and whom Kellan killed.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: A captured knight rescued by Kellan.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: A figure presented with the hag's cauldron who gifted ponies and bore responsibility for the curse.

entities.name: Troyan
entities.description: A vedalken who guided Kellan and Ruby up the beanstalk.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch with an ice castle in Loch Larent who gave Ruby a sword.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A figure at Castle Ardenvale whom Will's knights captured.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker who captured Kellan and Ruby and escaped.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker whose knights assaulted Castle Ardenvale.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who appeared at Castle Ardenvale and was subdued.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: A figure Kellan sought up the beanstalk.

entities.name: Dunbarrow
entities.description: Place Kellan and Ruby traveled to.

entities.name: Edgewall Keep
entities.description: Keep near where Ruby's cabin stood.

entities.name: Stormkeld
entities.description: Place at the top of the beanstalk.

events.summary: After her brother goes missing, Ruby meets Kellan and they travel to Dunbarrow.
events.quote: After her brother went missing, she met Kellan and the two traveled to Dunbarrow

events.summary: Kellan slays Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron and rescues Imodane; the Wolf Knight is revealed to be Peter.
events.quote: Kellan slew the witch by pushing her into her cauldron

events.summary: Guided by Troyan, Kellan and Ruby climb the beanstalk to Stormkeld.
events.quote: Kellan and Ruby climbed up the beanstalk to Stormkeld

events.summary: Ruby carries Kellan to Hylda's portcullis; Hylda relents, revives Kellan, gives Ruby a sword and relinquishes her crown.
events.quote: Hylda relented, reviving Kellan, gifting Ruby a sword, relinquishing her crown

events.summary: Captured by Rowan Kenrith, Kellan and Ruby escape when Will Kenrith's knights assault Castle Ardenvale; Eriette is captured and Rowan escapes.
events.quote: allowing Will's knights to capture Eriette, though Rowan escaped
